name: Nubank
tagline: Revolutionizing banking with zero fee digital financial services.
description: Nubank is the largest fintech and digital banking platform in Latin America, delivering transparent financial services, no-fee credit cards, and wealth management tools to over 90 million users.

name: Wellhub (Gympass)
tagline: Corporate wellness and global fitness network platform.
description: Wellhub connects enterprise employees with the world's largest ecosystem of gyms, wellness studios, personal trainers, and mental health apps to foster holistic employee wellbeing.

name: Agrosmart
tagline: Climate intelligence and data analytics for sustainable agriculture.
description: Agrosmart delivers predictive climate analytics, soil monitoring sensors, and satellite insights to empower agribusinesses, farmers, and supply chains to optimize irrigation and reduce carbon footprints.

name: Hotmart
tagline: Global creator economy and digital education ecosystem.
description: Hotmart provides an end-to-end commerce and distribution platform for digital content creators, online course educators, and infopreneurs scaling businesses across 180 countries.

name: QuintoAndar
tagline: Streamlining residential rentals and home buying end-to-end.
description: QuintoAndar transforms real estate by eliminating guarantor requirements for tenants, providing guaranteed rental payments to property owners, and providing seamless paperless digital contracts.

name: Loft
tagline: Tech-driven real estate platform powering home liquidity.
description: Loft uses machine learning pricing algorithms and a nationwide broker MLS marketplace to make buying, renovating, and financing residential properties fast, secure, and transparent.

name: Soliens
tagline: Distributed solar energy tech and residential clean power solutions.
description: Soliens combines proprietary IoT energy monitors, automated engineering software, and affordable solar leasing to accelerate green energy adoption across Brazilian residences and micro-businesses.

name: Frete.com (CargoX)
tagline: Uber for freight trucks in South America.
description: Frete.com connects autonomous truck drivers with corporate shippers to maximize logistics efficiency, reduce empty return trips, and lower highway transport carbon emissions across Brazil.

name: Asaas
tagline: Automated financial operating system for SMBs.
description: Asaas automates billing, recurring invoicing, Pix instant payments, bank integrations, and credit underwriting for over 150,000 small and medium-sized Brazilian companies.

name: Alice
tagline: Health insurance reimagined with personalized preventative care.
description: Alice is a full-stack corporate health manager that pairs members with dedicated healthcare teams (physicians, nutritionists, nurses) available 24/7 via mobile app, prioritizing health prevention.

name: Gupy
tagline: AI-powered recruitment, applicant tracking, and employee education.
description: Gupy leverages proprietary artificial intelligence to reduce unconscious hiring bias, streamline candidate selection, and provide corporate training programs for over 3,000 enterprise employers.

name: Omie
tagline: Cloud ERP and embedded financial services for micro-enterprises.
description: Omie offers intuitive cloud enterprise management software that combines accounting, tax compliance, inventory control, and digital banking directly integrated with accountant portals.

name: Sensix
tagline: Drone and satellite imagery platform for precision agriculture.
description: Sensix builds FieldScan, an agronomic software platform synthesizing multispectral drone imagery, satellite indices, and soil variability maps to recommend targeted fertilizer application.

name: RD Station
tagline: Inbound marketing automation and customer relationship software.
description: RD Station is the leading Latin American marketing and sales automation ecosystem, helping businesses generate qualified leads, nurture pipelines, and increase customer lifetime value.

name: Trybe
tagline: Career-focused software engineering and AI education school.
description: Trybe trains high-performing software engineers, full-stack web developers, and data science professionals with an intensive curriculum focused on real-world industry readiness.

name: ManejeBem
tagline: Agronomic assistance and supply-chain ESG traceability software.
description: ManejeBem empowers smallholder farmers and food supply chains with digital agronomic diagnosis, crop protection guidelines, and verified ESG compliance reporting for global food exporters.

name: Pipefy
tagline: No-code business process automation and enterprise workflow management.
description: Pipefy empowers knowledge workers and managers to build custom automated workflows, procurement approval loops, and HR ticketing systems without writing code.

name: Revelo
tagline: Remote tech talent platform connecting Latin American developers to US companies.
description: Revelo operates a curated marketplace for hiring pre-vetted Latin American tech talent, handling payroll compliance, cross-border benefits, and high-performance engineering matchmaking.
